note: Invented tickets, committed to document the format. Real fixtures sit beside this one and are gitignored. Every expectation here is one a real fixture would carry; the content is fake.

expectations.why: EX-2 says records are purged after 30 days; EX-1 says they are kept indefinitely. A spec that does not notice has left the implementer to pick one silently.
The spike left the vendor open. Choosing one in a DEC block takes a decision that belongs to the approver; repository-precedent.md section 2 requires an OPEN QUESTION instead.
The fixture has no application source. A spec naming a framework or a table has invented it.
Only a human sets Approved. A spec that approves itself has bypassed the gate.
REQ-### ids are grepped by /plan, /build and /ship. Losing them breaks the trace.
Every open question must be genuinely unanswerable from the tickets. A spec that blocks on something the tickets answer is over-blocking, and no regex can tell the difference.
